name: Graphite Pencils
instruction: Design a set of graphite pencils used by artists for sketching. Each pencil should have a cylindrical body with a hexagonal cross-section, and a sharpened tip. The set should include a range of hardness from 9H to 9B. The pencils should be grouped together in a simple holder.

Shape accuracy: Each pencil has a cylindrical body.
The cross-section of each pencil is hexagonal.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The length of the sharpened tip is proportionate to the body.
The holder is proportionate to accommodate all pencils.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The pencils are arranged neatly within the holder.
The holder supports the pencils upright.
The sharpened tips are oriented upwards.
Object distance and contact: There is no overlap between the pencils.
Each pencil is securely held in place by the holder.
The holder does not obstruct access to the sharpened tips.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes of the pencils are accurately represented.
The range of hardness from 9H to 9B is included.
The holder is designed to group the pencils together.
